A1.question: List the Episode of all TV series sorted by rating.

steps.result:
3 tables:
  Cartoon (12 rows)
  TV_Channel (15 rows)
  TV_series (12 rows)

CREATE TABLE "TV_series" (
  "id" REAL PRIMARY KEY,
  "Episode" TEXT,
  "Air_Date" TEXT,
  "Rating" TEXT,
  "Share" REAL,
  "18_49_Rating_Share" TEXT,
  "Viewers_m" TEXT,
  "Weekly_Rank" REAL,
  "Channel" TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY ("Channel") REFERENCES "TV_Channel" ("id")
);
